title: Corrupted by the Black Swan
description:
The tale of Swan Lake is ballet’s most famous performance, and as a dancer myself, I was delighted when someone suggested I do a file based on it.

Taking inspiration for the act after our hero falls in love with the beautiful and innocent swan, Odette, we pick up as the evil Odile appears to try steal him away. In this interpretation of the story, I play both Odette and Odile… but can you know which of us is which?

And more importanly, can you resist the magic spell being cast upon you… and can Odette? Or will you both be corrupted by dark magic, and honeyed words from the black swan?

Art by Judith Blue_Orchid
author: Mistress Calia
